name: MakeHuman Characters
author: Heaven3D (assets: MakeHuman / MPFB 2 community, CC0)
description: Create realistic humans in the editor (MPFB2 / MakeHuman body morphs, 66 skins, 175 CC0 clothes, 34 hair styles, eyes, brows), rigged with the Mixamo skeleton and GPU-skinned. Drop in Mixamo animations or use the built-in ones. NPCs that walk paths, enemies that patrol, chase and attack, with foot IK. Everything is CC0: free for commercial games, no credit needed.
